name: Skip Prologue and Welcome Level
description: On a brand-new save, skips both the "Once upon a time..." stork prologue (game modes $37/$38/$39) and the Welcome To Yoshi's Island tutorial level - a fresh save goes straight to the world map at 1-1, exactly like a returning save. Mutually exclusive with "Skip Prologue".  Made with AI.
details: The new-game branch (CODE_179932, Bank17 $17:9932) sets gm$1F (fade -> gm$20 prepare overworld -> world map), then tests the per-save progress byte: 'LDA $1123,x : BNE rts' at $17:994E. A zero (never-cleared) save falls through into the gm$37 prologue override.

This chunk flips that BNE ($17:9951, label CODE_179932 + $1F) from $D0 to $80 (BRA), so every save takes the returning-save exit: the override block becomes dead code and the game proceeds gm$1F -> world map with CurrentLevelFromMap = $0 (1-1) straight from the zeroed save block.
The skipped 'STZ CurrentYoshiColor ($0383)' is non-essential (fresh-save RAM is already zeroed; returning saves never run it).

Composes safely with "Skip Prologue": the byte ranges do not overlap, and the BRA simply makes the other patch's rewritten block unreachable (this patch wins). Still, enable only one - they express opposite intents.
Byte layout verified against the built USA V1.0 cart (PC 0xB9951: D0 08).
